newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE to suspend Nagorno-Karabakh monitoring.
newsitem.headline: OSCE to suspend Nagorno-Karabakh monitoring.

text.p: Europe's top security forum said on Thursday it would suspend its monitoring activities in the breakaway Nagorno-Karabakh region on the border between Azerbaijan and Armenia because of danger to its staff.
The Vienna-based Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) said in a statement recent shooting incidents had jeopardised the safety of its personnel in the region.

"After shooting incidents in April and November 1996, the (OSCE) Personal Representative decided that future monitoring would be carried out only after notification to and consent from the respective parties," the OSCE said.
A fragile ceasefire has been in place since 1994 in the enclave of Nagorno-Karabakh, subject of a nine-year dispute between the majority ethnic Armenian population, Armenia and Moslem Azerbaijan.
